project.name: BeamNG.Earth
project.description: A streamed Earth for BeamNG.drive, built from real elevation, imagery and map data.

sources.description: Road widths, lanes, surface, sidewalks, lighting and raceways, read from OSM US Layercake.
Lane details and roundabout tags retained in the weekly OSM lane shards; individual values may have partial rendering support.
Railway ways and crossing/catenary nodes retained in the weekly OSM railway shards; not every retained value produces a distinct model.
Identify and name mapped fuel stations and EV charging stations.
Identify mapped picnic tables and picnic sites.
Select active individual wind turbines and determine their placement and dimensions.
Exit destinations, road references and lane context used to lay out highway signs.
Mapped highway milestones and route/direction references.
